title: A 16x16 grass-on-dirt autotile set with a preview map
fixture: for i, h in ipairs(hx) do p:setColor(i, Color(tonumber(h:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(h:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(h:sub(5, 6), 16))) end
steps: /skill:make-tileset Make a 16x16 grass-on-dirt autotile set (47 tiles) in this sprite's palette, with a preview map. Don't export files.
Make the grass edge more irregular, with a few grass tufts hanging over the dirt, and update the set and the preview.
